summary: Frontend-only verification of Profile Focus Lock confirmation modal (replaced web-incompatible Alert.alert). All primary flows PASS on mobile web viewport (390x844). OFF path is immediate (no modal, focus-lock-warning hidden, PATCH /api/settings persists focus_lock_enabled=false). Re-ON opens focus-lock-confirm-modal with correct 60-second tree-death warning text. Cancel closes modal and leaves setting OFF. 'Turn on' closes modal, persists focus_lock_enabled=true and re-renders red focus-lock-warning. Timer tab focus-lock-banner correctly reads 'Focus Lock is on' after tab switch. Regression: Profile tab renders stats, weekly recap, streak calendar, badges, PayPal buy-freeze-button, notifications-switch (toggling persists via PATCH), and logout-button. Notifications toggle also persists and was restored. Final user state left as required: notifications_enabled=true, focus_lock_enabled=true; plant plant_f950c13f4790 alive (is_dead=false).
critical_code_review_comments: profile.tsx line 45: initial settings state defaults to {notifications_enabled:true, focus_lock_enabled:true} before /api/settings resolves. This is fine for UX but if load() fails silently the switch may show ON while the server has it OFF; consider showing a loading skeleton for the Settings section.

toggleFocusLock(false) calls saveSetting which sets state optimistically THEN awaits PATCH. If PATCH fails the optimistic OFF is never rolled back — only 'settings err' is logged. Consider surfacing the error to user.
